item.title: Persona 5 fan-made fighting game project receives updated gameplay footage that's cool enough to look like the real deal
item.description: <p>The fighting game fan development community has been on fire lately in a good way, and there's no shortage of cool projects to take a look at.</p> <p>One we previously got to see in action was the impressive unnamed <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/aug/19/persona-5-fan-fighting-game/">Persona 5 fighting game project</a> last year, and now the community can get a glimpse as to how its progressing.</p>

item.title: Alex Arrives Fighting Pass trailer released for Street Fighter 6 with new costume colors for Zangief, Akuma and more content
item.description: <p>After months of waiting, the time for <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/21/alex-gameplay-trailer-sf6/">Alex's arrival</a> is finally almost here, and <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> players should already know what that means.</p> <p>Capcom just revealed the Alex Arrives Fighting Pass for Street Fighter 6 that'll be available very soon.</p>

item.title: First full match footage for Alex revealed in Street Fighter 6, and there's a ton to look at including his Critical Arts
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/21/alex-gameplay-trailer-sf6/">Alex</a> is finally set to drop into the ring for <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> in a few weeks, and we can get a taste of the action heading our way now.</p> <p>Quite a few Japanese publications as well as <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@gamespot">GameSpot</a> have released the first real match footage of Alex's new incarnation, and there's a lot to look at.</p>

item.title: Capcom Spotlight stream announced including news for Street Fighter 6... So maybe it's time for new costumes?
item.description: <p>Capcom appears to be continuing their hot streak of releases with the recent critical and fan praised heaped upon Resident Evil: Requiem, but they've got even more ahead on their calendar.</p> <p>The company just announced their latest Capcom Spotlight showcase scheduled to take place later this week.</p>

item.title: New Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls gameplay demonstration details 10 big changes made from feedback, especially for assists
item.description: <p>Although <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/marvel-tokon/">Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls</a> is still around five months out from release, the game has already run two closed beta tests to let the public try out the heroes and villains.</p> <p>Many players had issues or concerns with the directions of Marvel Tokon's gameplay after those tests, and it seems the developers are taking that feedback to heart.</p>

item.title: Capcom reveals plans to align Street Fighter game marketing initiatives with the upcoming movie's release
item.description: <p>Capcom has released a <a href='https://www.capcom.co.jp/ir/english/data/pdf/explanation/2025/3rd/explanation_2025_3rd_02.pdf'>Q&A summary</a> for their third quarter consolidated financial results conference call for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026. The information mentioned here is updated up to January 27, 2026.</p> <p>Of course, since Street Fighter 6 is the latest fighting game released by Capcom, it received a few mentions in the Q&A summary document. item.title: Dupli-Kate unveiled for Invincible Vs in new gameplay trailer
item.description: <p>Dupli-Kate has been revealed for <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/invincible-vs/'>Invincible Vs</a>. A new gameplay trailer has dropped that showcases the new fighter in action.</p> <p>As one can probably guess from her name, Dupli-Kate has the ability to... well, duplicate herself. During gameplay, she can generate copies of herself that will then attack her opponents.</p>

item.title: Alex character guide released for Street Fighter 6

item.title: What I've heard about the situation with Street Fighter 6's costumes
item.description: <p>I was asked on a recent episode of the <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w01iP6-BZTQ">StayMAD Podcast</a> what's going on with the lack of costumes in Street Fighter 6, and I wanted to tell our readers what I've heard as well.</p> <p>I've heard that Capcom shifted around a lot of their amazingly talented and hard-working artists to put resources into Monster Hunter instead of Street Fighter 6.</p>
